notes: Verified live 2026-10-07 in headed Chrome from a residential connection, read only. The state scoped name page /people-search/john-smith/texas/ lists 20 people per page with #container-persons .person cards, so the recipe builds it with {{state|state_name|slug}} ("NY" becomes new-york) and the scan no longer returns people from every state. A card has an h2 ("name in City, State | Age - N", so the name field carries that extra text because the name is a bare text node), a .details block of phones, address, relatives and previous locations, and a "View Full Report" link a.view that goes to a /search/ funnel URL built from the first name, last name, city and state. Two people in the same city share that URL, so only the first of them is listed; this is why a nationwide scan showed 15 candidates from 20 cards. Emails are blurred and left out. A name with no match in the state answers 404, which reads as no candidates. Known gap: the District of Columbia has no state page (every spelling tried answers 404), so a scan for a DC profile reports no candidates even though people exist there. The Cloudflare check on this site passed in a plain Chrome and blocked a Playwright launched Chrome after a few quick page loads, so a run may end as bot_detection. A common name has more matches than the first page shows.
